name: invompt
description: Invompt helps you create, review, and revise billing documents in a conversation, then export an existing invoice as a PDF.

interface.longDescription: Create or manage invoices from natural-language requests. Use the same workflow for quotes and estimates; a pro forma is represented as a quote. Reuse saved clients and settings, inspect hosted review links, revise the selected document, and export an existing invoice as a PDF. You control document changes; Invompt does not send email or process payments.
defaultPrompt: Create a quote from this conversation. Ask for any missing billing details before saving it.
Find the selected invoice, show its current total and hosted review link, then help me review a proposed change.
Export an existing Invompt invoice as a PDF.
